verdict.rationale: Docs claim libraries for '50+ platforms' and iOS-specific features (pre-main app-start monitoring, Flutter CPU/memory/FPS on iOS+Android), and a community reviewer confirms hands-on use of the iOS SDK auto-reporting fatal errors. However, there is no explicit documentation or evidence of Android or NDK native-crash capture, symbolication, or the specific device/OS/app-version metadata bundled with crash reports.  missing for 10: explicit Android SDK crash capture evidence, NDK/native-crash symbolication details, explicit documentation of device/OS/app-version context fields captured per crash.
